title: How many notes of each kind make an amount?
description: Harpreet's father changes his rupees into notes. The video counts notes of ten, one hundred, one thousand and five hundred by cutting the number.
teaching_notes: One idea: cutting off digits from the end of the amount counts notes of ten, one hundred or one thousand, and five hundred needs groups of five hundreds. Watch for the number of hundreds being used as the number of five hundreds.

source: How many notes of 10, of 100, of 1,000 and of 500 are there
video_script.why: The child reads place value but has not yet used it to count how many notes of each kind make an amount.
video_script.substitution: Cut the digits off the end to count tens, hundreds and thousands, and group the hundreds in fives for notes of five hundred.
video_script.anchor: Harpreet's father changing his rupees into notes
video_script.wrong_move: Chintu uses the thirty-two hundreds as the number of notes of five hundred. Thirty-two counts notes of one hundred, so notes of five hundred are fewer.
video_script.payoff_line: there are three hundred and twenty-five notes of ten

final_answer.value: 325 notes of 10, 32 notes of 100, 3 notes of 1,000 and 6 notes of 500
final_answer.spoken: three hundred and twenty-five notes of ten, thirty-two notes of one hundred, three notes of one thousand and six notes of five hundred

never_show: your-turn answers: 648 notes of 10 and 12 notes of 500
maths_rules: 3,250 has 325 tens, 32 hundreds with 50 left, and 3 thousands with 250 left
notes of 10: 325; notes of 100: 32; notes of 1,000: 3
slip: 32 notes of 500 = 16,000, which is far more than 3,250
notes of 500: 32 hundreds is 5 hundreds six times with 2 hundreds over, so 6 notes of 500
your turn: 6,480 has 648 tens and 64 hundreds; 64 hundreds is 5 hundreds twelve times with 4 over, so 12 notes of 500; never shown
video_script.design: One idea: cut off digits to count notes, and group hundreds in fives for five hundred. Wrong idea: hundreds as notes of five hundred. The pile of notes stays on the stage.

<bookmark mark='ask'/>How many notes of ten, of one hundred, of one thousand and of five hundred make this much?

narration: <bookmark mark='cut'/>To count notes, cut the number after some digits. The digits left of the cut tell the number of notes.
<bookmark mark='one'/>A cut before the last digit counts notes of ten.
<bookmark mark='two'/>A cut before the last two digits counts notes of one hundred. A cut before the last three digits counts notes of one thousand.

narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Thirty-two notes of five hundred, because there are thirty-two hundreds.
<bookmark mark='slip'/>Thirty-two counts the notes of one hundred.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Thirty-two notes of five hundred would be sixteen thousand rupees, far more than we have.

narration: <bookmark mark='ten'/>Cut before the last digit. The digits left of the cut count the notes of ten.
<bookmark mark='pay'/>There are three hundred and twenty-five notes of ten.
<bookmark mark='hun'/>Cut before the last two digits for notes of one hundred. That gives thirty-two notes.
<bookmark mark='thou'/>Cut before the last three digits for notes of one thousand. That gives three notes.

narration: <bookmark mark='five'/>For notes of five hundred, start from the thirty-two hundreds.
<bookmark mark='grp'/>Five hundreds fit into thirty-two hundreds six times, with two hundreds left over.
<bookmark mark='six'/>There are six notes of five hundred.
